top_news.title: Onshore Yuan Snaps Winning Streak as PBOC Lifts FX Reserve Ratio
top_news.summary: The onshore yuan ended its longest winning streak in three decades after the People’s Bank of China moved to cool its rally by asking banks to hold more foreign currencies in reserve.

top_news.title: Gold Holds Biggest Jump in Two Months on Iran Peace-Deal Hopes
top_news.summary: Gold was steady, after jumping the most in two months on Monday as hopes of a breakthrough in US-Iran peace talks sent oil prices plunging and eased anxiety over accelerating inflation.

top_news.title: Reliance’s Record $19 Billion Surge Lifts Nifty, Keeps India Bulls in the Game
top_news.summary: Reliance’s more than $19 billion surge in market value marks the biggest single-day gain for any Indian company.

top_news.title: Asian Stocks Fall After US Losses, Oil Holds Drop: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Asian stocks declined after a selloff in US chipmakers deepened, overshadowing a plunge in oil prices amid optimism over diplomatic progress toward ending the war in Iran.

top_news.title: China’s Revival of 2024 Stock Rescue Tools Faces Skepticism
top_news.summary: China is reviving the tools it deployed during the 2024 stock selloff, a playbook that market participants say may stem a further rout but fall short of reigniting equity gains.

top_news.title: China's He Lifeng on Hong Kong's Financial Edge
top_news.summary: China's Vice Premier He Lifeng urges Hong Kong to utilize its One Country, Two Systems governance model to foster openness to global trade. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: BAI Capital Closing in on $800 Million for New USD Fund
top_news.summary: BAI Capital's Managing Partner Annabelle Yu Long told Bloomberg that the firm is nearing $700 million of an $800 million target as it attracts European LPs and Chinese strategic investors. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Franklin Templeton CEO Hopes Indonesia Changes on MSCI Warning
top_news.summary: Franklin Templeton’s Jenny Johnson said the warning from MSCI Inc. to Indonesia will be constructive, giving extra impetus for the country to improve governance and transparency in its equities market.

top_news.title: Leaked File Put Lenders in Bind Before Acrisure’s Earnings Win
top_news.summary: Insurance brokerage and fintech Acrisure reported third-quarter earnings that showed an improvement in broker retention, after a period in which it inadvertently gave creditors access to an internal spreadsheet then demanded they not act on the financial metrics they might have seen.

top_news.title: Oracle Seeks $20 Billion for AI Growth as Meta Weighs New Debt
top_news.summary: For almost three months, Big Tech companies didn’t borrow in the US bond market after they spooked investors with a debt binge in the hundreds of billions of dollars. Now they’re flooding in again.
